architecture.summary: A workflow, one script message, and documents change; no runtime behavior of Thermus changes. The deploy job of .github/workflows/hosted-image.yml now names the GitHub environment production, which the manager created on 31 October 2026 with a deployment branch rule that allows only main. GitHub refuses a job of the environment on another branch before the job starts, and only a job of the environment can read the secrets of the environment. The release key moves to the secret RENDER_API_KEY of the environment (owner step); the repository secret stays until the first dispatch on main passes, and until then the job reads the environment secret first. The build job, the inputs, the request check with its branch rule, the GHCR check, the Render API calls, and the permissions do not change. The message of script/release/deploy-hosted-image.ts for an empty key names the environment secret. The README section Hosted release and runbook 5.1 give the new place of the key and the rotation with gh secret set --env production. policy: the change edits a policy path and changes which workflow runs can reach the release key. sensitiveBehavior: it narrows the authorization of a credential that can deploy production, and the deploy and rollback dispatches need the environment secret after the repository secret goes. No src, test, migration, or Mermaid block changes, so no container, component, edge, public module, or declaration changes.
